exclusion_detail: Lead 1d is made in one step from the 5-aminopyrazole intermediate 3a and 3-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl isocyanate, but 3a is 'prepared as previously reported' (ref. 24) with no procedure in this paper, and no SI is in the bundle.

lead.label: 1d
lead.why: Abstract: 'Notably, 1d, bearing a meta-trifluoromethylphenyl group linked to the carbamate moiety, proved to be the most active candidate.'

notes: All compounds of the paper (1a-d, 2a-d) start from 3a/3b, both 'prepared as previously reported'; so none qualifies. Final step for reference: 3a + isocyanate, dry DMF, 100 C, 12 h, 43% for 1d.
